profile.headline: Freelance Senior Systems/Software Engineer | Linux, Active Directory
profile.summary:
Experienced Full Stack Developer and Systems Administrator always seeking interesting opportunities to leverage my credentials. Skilled at managing multiple clients and\or projects simultaneously. Recognized as a quick and adept problem solver, resourceful and disciplined.  

Specialties: 

 HTML, CSS, PHP, Javascript / jQuery, Laravel, Bootstrap, Underscore Js,  Angular Js, Git, MYSQL
 
AWS, Active Directory, VMware, IIS, Apache, DNS, RSA SecurID, Shibboleth, Wordpress, Load Balancing / High Availability, Nessus Vulnerability Scanner, Account Management, Cloud Computing, Virtualization, Data Centre Architecture, Backup Solutions, Exchange, Office 365, Google Apps

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and managed AWS cloud infrastructure supporting production applications
- Developed frontend infrastructure using Svelte to improve performance and user experience
- Implemented workflow automation using n8n, improving operational efficiency
- Built and maintained full-stack applications using Node.js and Docker
- Ensured application reliability, scalability, and security in cloud environments

positions.title: Senior Solutions Architect/System Administrator/Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Built and managed AWS infrastructure, driving innovative solutions at MindHyv.  
• Developed Svelte infrastructure to enhance user interface capabilities, improving user experience.  
• Managed N8N for seamless workflow automation, significantly boosting operational efficiency.  
• Utilized Node.js and Docker for full-stack development, ensuring robust application performance.

positions.title: Design Consultant
positions.description:
- Delivered full-stack web applications using PHP, Laravel, AngularJS, ASP.NET, and JavaScript
- Developed custom WordPress plugins and themes
- Integrated payment processing systems using SOAP and REST APIs
- Built Web3 applications and token-based functionality
- Led projects from architecture and development through deployment and maintenance

positions.title: Senior Systems/Software Engineer
positions.description:
•       Manage Amazon Web Services – ELB, EC2, S3, RDS, SNS, CloudWatch, CodeDeply, and CodePipeline.
•       Expertise in architecting VPC solutions in AWS.
•       Managing and maintain IAM policies across multiple accounts.
•       Used JIRA to track issues and Change Management.
•       Manage team of developers in India and Venezuela. 
•       Develop Serverless applications.
•       Build and manage applications in PHP and NodeJS.
•       Build and manage CI/CD pipelines with BitBucket Pipelines, Code Deploy and Code Pipeline.
•	Maintain an organized and secure, multiple network AWS-based cloud infrastructure.
•	Maintain highly used production Linux and Windows servers
•	Monitor all systems with Pingdom, healthchecks.io, and created a lambda function to monitor SSL expiration.
•	Build multiple auto-scaling systems that have multiple open ports for http access and other port access. Systems used CodeDeploy to ensure all load balanced servers are using the same code.
•	Manage shared file storage for load balanced systems.
•	Support SFTP and SSH access to multiple systems for several developers.
•	Perform cost analysis on which servers will handle the work.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and deployed serverless applications using Node.js and PHP on AWS Lambda
- Designed and maintained secure, scalable AWS infrastructure (VPC, RDS, CloudFront, Route 53)
- Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines supporting high-availability production systems
- Administered Docker containers and ECS environments
- Implemented monitoring, SSL validation, and uptime tracking using Pingdom and custom tooling
- Developed application features using Laravel, CodeIgniter, PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
- Managed VPN connectivity, SSH/SFTP access, and secure file sharing

positions.title: Freelance Senior Systems/Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and managed AWS infrastructure, ensuring scalability and performance for diverse client projects.  
• Developed complex web applications using a variety of technologies including PHP, C#, and JavaScript.  
• Customized WordPress websites and e-commerce platforms to meet unique client needs, enhancing user experience.

positions.title: Systems Administrator/Programmer
positions.description:
• Create, and maintain Virtual Machines and templates on VMware infrastructure
• Managed Active Directory 2003/2008 accounts, groups, topology, and group policy
• Designed, managed, and maintained multiple Windows and Linux servers
• Managed EMC VNX SAN and Netgear NAS
• Liaison to Computer Science Department
• Various additional IT related needs involving hardware, software, networks ect..
• Responsible for 24/7 primary and secondary on call support


Accomplishments
• Migrated entire Linux infrastructure to Red Hat Enterprise, aiding in stability and uniformity.
• Implemented Shibboleth single sign on system in a load balanced / high availability environment,
which opened the university to more possibilities for cloud solutions.
• Performed monthly security scans using Nessus Vulnerability Scanning tool, aiding in PCI
compliance.
• Developed and maintained an automated account provisioning and de-provisioning platform across
multiple systems, aiding in student satisfaction and network security.
• Wrote numerous scripts interfacing with Active Directory for generating reports, forcing password resets, and various other tasks.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
- Managed Windows and Linux servers and VMware infrastructure
- Administered Active Directory and automated user lifecycle processes
- Built automation for provisioning, de-provisioning, and reporting
- Migrated Linux infrastructure to Red Hat Enterprise Linux
- Deployed Shibboleth SSO in load-balanced, high-availability environments
- Conducted monthly Nessus vulnerability scans and remediation
